theme.description: Fun, vibrant, and clean social trip planner for Gen Z/Millennials. Optimistic pastel accents with crisp, high-contrast dark text for readability. Soft tactile cards with generous mobile-first spacing.

spacing_and_layout.app_container: max-w-md mx-auto h-screen bg-[#FAFAFA] relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col sm:border sm:border-slate-200 sm:shadow-2xl sm:rounded-[3rem]

bottom_nav.classes: absolute bottom-0 w-full h-20 flex justify-around items-center px-6 pb-4 pt-2 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-black/5
bottom_nav.active_icon: text-[#FF6B6B] scale-110 transition-transform flex flex-col items-center gap-1
bottom_nav.inactive_icon: text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 transition-colors flex flex-col items-center gap-1

trip_card.wrapper: w-full bg-white rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-slate-100 flex flex-col gap-3 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform
trip_card.image_container: w-full h-40 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden relative bg-slate-100
trip_card.date_pill: absolute top-3 left-3 px-3 py-1 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md rounded-full text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 shadow-sm

button_primary.classes: w-full py-4 bg-[#FF6B6B] hover:bg-[#fa5a5a] text-white font-bold rounded-full text-lg shadow-lg shadow-[#FF6B6B]/20 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex justify-center items-center gap-2

input_field.label: text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 ml-1
input_field.input: w-full px-5 py-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF6B6B]/20 focus:border-[#FF6B6B] outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400

home.description: Upcoming outings feed. Large cards representing trips.
home.layout: Header with 'Hi, [User]' and Avatar. 'Upcoming Outings' list of trip_cards. Floating Action Button or nav item for 'Create'.

create_outing.layout: Input fields for Name, Destination. Date Picker (Shadcn Calendar). Cover Photo upload placeholder. 'Next: Invite Friends' button.

outing_detail.layout: Hero image top with gradient overlay -> Title & Dates. Horizontal scroll tabs (Overview, Gallery, To-Do, Expenses). Members grid. Sticky bottom CTA 'Join' or 'Edit'.

memory_capsule.description: Scrapbook style feed of past trips.
memory_capsule.layout: Masonry or timeline view. Grayscale/sepia placeholders or polaroid-style white borders on cards rotated slightly.

expense_tracker.layout: Total spent big number. List of transactions with category icons. 'Add Expense' FAB.

profile.layout: Centered avatar, username. Invite code section (tap to copy). List of joined outings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build this as a mobile-first responsive web app. Constrain the main container to max-w-md and center it on larger screens (like a mobile emulator view).
Always use the provided image URLs for trip covers and user avatars. Do not use generic placeholders.
Use @phosphor-icons/react for the bottom tab bar and UI icons. They fit the fun, clean aesthetic perfectly.
Implement fluid, bouncy interactions. Wrap cards and buttons in framer-motion <motion.div whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }} />.
For the bottom nav, use a fixed position at the bottom of the max-w-md container, with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur).
Keep spacing generous (p-6, gap-4) and corner radii large (rounded-3xl for cards, rounded-full for buttons) to achieve the 2026 pastel app look.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements as per the testing rules.
